universe.title: Starship Troopers Universe
universe.description: The Starship Troopers universe is set in a future where humanity has expanded across the stars and faces existential threats from alien species, primarily the Arachnids (bugs). Society is organized around the Federated Suns, a militaristic democracy where citizenship is earned through Federal Service.
source_material: Starship Troopers novel by Robert A. Heinlein (1959)
Starship Troopers film by Paul Verhoeven (1997)

federated_suns.description: The Federated Suns is the governing body of human civilization, a constitutional republic where full citizenship and voting rights are granted only after completion of Federal Service (military, civil service, or teaching).

government.citizenship: Earned through Federal Service - military, civil service, or teaching in dangerous or remote areas

branches.executive: President of the Federated Suns, elected by citizen-voters
branches.legislative: Congress of the Federated Suns, representing citizen districts

government.philosophy: The central philosophical theme of the universe: only those who have served their fellow citizens deserve the right to govern them. 'Only bootstraps can correct the spine!'

mobile_infantry.description: The elite ground combat force of the Federated Suns. Mobile Infantry soldiers use powered armor with jump packs for rapid deployment and fold-space jumps between star systems.
mobile_infantry.motto: This message was sent by Mobile Infantry

equipment.powered_armor: Full-body powered armor suit with enhanced strength, protection, and mobility
equipment.jump_pack: Rocket-powered jump pack enabling short-range aerial movement and planetary insertion
equipment.plasma_rifle: Standard issue plasma rifle capable of penetrating Arachnid exoskeletons
equipment.communications: Integrated comms system for squad coordination

notable_units: Rasczak's Roughnecks - 3rd Platoon, led by Sergeant Zim Rasczak
Carmen's Fleet unit - Federal Fleet operations

federal_fleet.description: Space-based military force responsible for fold-space transport, orbital support, and fleet combat.
roles: Fold-space transport of Mobile Infantry between star systems

federal_cavalry.description: Armored ground forces operating tanks and mechanized vehicles on planetary surfaces.
roles: Planetary ground assault with armored vehicles
Mobile fire support for infantry operations

federal_reserve.description: Training and reserve forces for new recruits and backup units.

arachnids.description: Also known as 'bugs', Arachnids are an alien species native to Klendathu and other planets in their hive empire. They are a hive-minded species with a caste system and no individual consciousness outside the hive.

warrior.description: Primary combat caste, equipped with acid spray and powerful mandibles. Most common bug encountered in combat.
warrior.tactics: Swarm attacks, tunnel warfare, ambush from underground

cavalry.description: Larger, faster warriors capable of leaping great distances. More dangerous than standard warriors.

tanker.description: Massive armored units that serve as mobile artillery platforms. Extremely dangerous at long range.

commander.description: Intelligent leaders that coordinate Arachnid forces. Can direct multiple castes and adapt tactics.
commander.tactics: Directing swarm tactics, adapting to enemy strategies

plasma.description: Space-capable Arachnids that can project plasma energy in vacuum. Threaten human space operations.

brain_bug.description: The hive mind itself - the central intelligence controlling all Arachnid activity. Destroying the Brain Bug can cause entire colonies to fall into disarray.
brain_bug.importance: Primary strategic objective - destroying the Brain Bug is the key to winning the war

worker.description: Labor caste responsible for tunnel construction, resource gathering, and maintaining the hive infrastructure.

frost.description: Cold-adapted Arachnid variants found in frozen biomes. Specialized for cold-weather combat.
frost.tactics: Ambush in cold environments, ice tunnel warfare
frost.note: Introduced in Starship Troopers: Extermination Frost biome (2022)

abilities.tunnel_network: Extensive underground tunnel systems allow rapid movement and surprise attacks
abilities.acid_spray: Corrosive acid that can penetrate armor and burn through materials
abilities.hive_mind: Shared consciousness enables perfect coordination without communication delays
abilities.regeneration: Some castes can regenerate lost limbs or repair damage

fold_space.description: Fold space technology enables instantaneous travel across interstellar distances by folding space-time. This is the cornerstone of human military and civilian space travel.

fold_jump.description: Instantaneous jump from one point in space to another via fold space
risks: Navigation errors can strand ships in deep space
Enemy interference can disrupt fold jumps
Arachnid plasma bugs can threaten ships during fold preparation

game_mechanic.description: Mobile Infantry units can fold jump to planetary surfaces for rapid deployment
game_mechanic.failure_effect: Units deploy 2-4 hexes from target location

fold_rifle.description: Experimental weapon that uses fold space principles to bypass armor and deal direct damage to targets

game_mechanic.damage: Ignores armor, deals direct damage to unit

powered_armor.description: Advanced powered armor suits worn by Mobile Infantry, providing enhanced strength, protection, and mobility.
features: Integrated life support for vacuum operations
Weapon mounts for plasma rifles and support weapons

gravity_projection.description: Technology that manipulates gravitational fields for various purposes including ship propulsion and weapon systems.
applications: Weapon systems that manipulate gravity to crush targets

nuclear_weapons.description: Nuclear demolition munitions used for area denial and destroying Arachnid hives. Last resort due to collateral damage.
types: Portable nuclear demolition charges for ground use
nuclear_weapons.restrictions: Use restricted by rules of engagement due to collateral damage risk

key_battles.name: Battle of Klendathu
key_battles.description: The first major human assault on the Arachnid homeworld. A devastating defeat for humanity, with massive casualties and no strategic gain. The 'Bug Hunt' became a symbol of the futility of conventional warfare against the Arachnids.
key_battles.significance: Taught humanity that brute force alone cannot defeat the Arachnids

key_battles.name: Battle of Buenos Aires
key_battles.description: First Arachnid attack on Earth, demonstrating the bugs' capability to strike human homeworld. The plasma bug threat was first revealed.
key_battles.outcome: Human victory, but at great cost
key_battles.significance: Proved Earth was vulnerable, accelerated military expansion

key_battles.name: Battle of Wyeworld
key_battles.description: Mobile Infantry operation to destroy an Arachnid Brain Bug on Wyeworld. A successful mission that demonstrated the effectiveness of targeting the hive mind.
key_battles.significance: Proved that destroying Brain Bugs is the key to winning the war

key_battles.name: Battle of Metal
key_battles.description: Assault on an Arachnid colony world with industrial capabilities. Revealed that Arachnids can adapt and evolve new castes.

philosophical_themes.citizenship_through_service: Only those who have served their fellow citizens deserve the right to vote and hold office
philosophical_themes.military_as_civilizing_force: The military is the backbone of civilization and the path to true adulthood
philosophical_themes.war_as_necessity: War is inevitable in a universe with hostile aliens; peace is maintained through strength
philosophical_themes.individual_vs_collective: Human individuality contrasts with Arachnid hive mind - a central theme of the conflict
philosophical_themes.brain_trust: The collective intelligence of all citizens, accessible through neural implants, represents the pinnacle of human cooperation

notable_characters.name: Johnny Rico
notable_characters.role: Protagonist - Mobile Infantry recruit who rises through the ranks
notable_characters.arc: From privileged youth to seasoned soldier and officer

notable_characters.name: Sergeant Zim Rasczak
notable_characters.fate: Killed in action during the Battle of Wyeworld

notable_characters.name: Carolina 'Carmen' Ibanez
notable_characters.role: Rico's love interest - Federal Fleet pilot
notable_characters.arc: From academy cadet to fleet officer

notable_characters.name: Dizzy Flores
notable_characters.role: Mobile Infantry soldier and Rico's friend
notable_characters.fate: Killed in action during the Battle of Klendathu

notable_characters.name: President Juan R. Peron
notable_characters.role_description: Leader of human civilization during the Arachnid war

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Humanity's homeworld and capital of the Federated Suns. Target of Arachnid attacks.

planets.name: Klendathu
planets.description: Arachnid homeworld. Site of the first major human assault and devastating defeat.

planets.name: Buenos Aires
planets.description: Former human colony on Earth, site of first Arachnid attack on the homeworld.

planets.name: Wye
planets.description: Colony world with an Arachnid Brain Bug. Site of successful Mobile Infantry operation.

planets.name: Metal
planets.description: Colony world with Arachnid industrial capabilities.

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: Human colony and training world. Site of Mobile Infantry training facilities.

planets.name: Isperia
planets.description: Human colony world, site of training exercises and deployments.
